resources.string: Encri Files has not been let into your vault yet, or was let in before this version was installed. encri asks you, on its own screen, what this app may see.
Other apps are not allowed into the vault: that is turned off in encri. encri can turn it on when it asks you about this app.
encri is not installed. Encri Files shows what is in an encri vault, so it needs encri on this phone.
The encri on this phone is not signed by a key this app trusts, so this app will not talk to it. The SHA-256 of its certificate is %1$s.
The encri on this phone is too old for this app. It speaks version %1$d of the protocol apps use to reach it. Update encri.
This folder is no longer in the vault.
This folder could not be listed.

When this is on, Encri Files shows a small picture of each photo and video in a folder. encri makes each picture and hands it to this app, which keeps it in memory only, never on the phone\'s storage, and drops them all when the vault locks. When it is off, this app asks encri for no pictures at all and shows names alone. This changes Encri Files alone: what other apps\' file pickers show is set in encri.

When this is off, Android blocks screenshots and screen recordings of Encri Files, keeps it off any screen you cast to, and shows a blank card for it among your recent apps. When it is on, anything this app shows, such as the names and previews of what is in your vault, can be captured, and a screenshot is kept in your photos, outside the vault, where photo backups and other apps can reach it. This changes Encri Files alone: encri\'s own screens always block screenshots.
